name: 神魂神社本殿
checkpoints: ONE raised taisha-zukuri main shrine, two-bay by two-bay body, thick posts and steep gabled wood-shingle roof.
Preserve projecting crossed chigi at both gable peaks, horizontal katsuogi ridge logs and high veranda. Gable-side doorway is off-center and stairs approach from right.
Only the high LEFT honden and its entry stairs/small entry cover; no lower right worship hall, trees or outer fence.
